message.content:
Based on the screenshot, here is a detailed description of the page and its contents:

### **Page Identification**
This is the **Performance Overview** page (also labeled **"Penilaian Kinerja"** in Indonesian) within the **RekanKerja HR Suite**. It is specifically for **PT Mitra Industri Internasional** (shown as "TRIAL" status). The page serves as the main dashboard for performance management, showing live data from appraisal cycles, KPIs, check-ins, and calibration.

---

### **Visible Headings & Sections**
1.  **Header:** `PERFORMANCE • PENILAIAN KINERJA`
2.  **Main Title:** `Performance Overview`
3.  **Sub-description:** Explains the module covers: *appraisal cycles → KPI targets → check-ins → appraisal → calibration → consequences (merit, PA, PIP, letters).*
4.  **Button:** `Manage Performance Masters` (blue CTA button)
5.  **Chart/Section Title:** `Final Rating Distribution (all cycles)`
6.  **Section Title:** `Form Status` (partially obscured by popup)
7.  **Section Title:** `Module Menu Map`

---

### **Summary Cards (Top Row)**
Four metric cards are displayed with large numbers:
*   **2** — Appraisal Cycles
*   **0** — Active Participants (r...)
*   **40** — Active KPI Library
*   **12** — Active Competencies

---

### **Rating Distribution Bars (with Numbers)**
This horizontal bar chart shows the distribution of final ratings across all cycles:

| Rating Level | Count | Bar Color |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1 - Very Poor** | **4** | Red/Pink |
| **2 - Poor** | **0** | Light Gray/Empty |
| **3 - Satisfactory** | **5** | Yellow/Orange |
| **4 - Good** | **5** | Green |
| **5 - Outstanding** | **5** | Teal/Dark Green |

*(Total rated employees: 19)*

---

### **Status Distribution**
Located under the **"Form Status"** heading (partially covered by an "Install the RekanKerja app" popup), the visible text shows:
> **PIP:** 1 active • 1 recovered / 2 not recovered (recovery rate 33%)

---

### **Module Menu Map**
This section lists the available sub-modules with icons and descriptions:
*   **Appraisal Cycles** — Open cycles, enroll participants, phase gates + Command Center nudge
*   **Goals & KPI** — KPI Builder + copy from previous cycle + Excel import
*   **Check-ins** — Documented 1-on-1s + mid-year progress
*   **Appraisals** — Self → manager → 360, auto-pull, AI assist, impact estimate
*   **Calibration** — Distribution + bell curve + audited decisions
*   **Results & 9-Box** — Publication, acknowledgement, appeals, talent lens
*   **PIP** — 1-3 month improvement program; mini-KPI targets, checkpoints, outcome
*   **Probation Evaluation** — Probation decisions from recruitment hires
*   **Reports** — Catalog of 14 bilingual report documents (pf11–pf44), print + XLSX ready

---

### **Other Elements**
*   **Sidebar Navigation:** Shows "Overview" is active, with other menu items like Siklus Penilaian, Target & KPI, Check-In, Penilaian, Kalibrasi, Hasil & 9-Box, PIP, Evaluasi Masa Percobaan, etc.
*   **Popup Modal:** A dark overlay prompting to **"Install the RekanKerja app"** for faster access.
*   **Footer:** © 2026 RekanKerja HR Suite - Performance
